claim: In the HWA 10.2.8 WSL2 laboratory, the active production plan file used by the master is /opt/hwa/TWSDATA/Symphony: the batchman process (PID 167635) keeps fd 11 open on it. The legacy /opt/hwa/TWSDATA/Sinfonia file is NOT used by batchman and keeps a static mtime (2026-08-27 15:10) even after planman deploy writes a new Symphony (2026-08-27 18:13, same size 505376). Watching Sinfonia to diagnose "Symphony file not updated" produces a false plan-corruption diagnosis.
source_title: Symphony active file vs legacy Sinfonia
supporting_quote: batchman fd 11 -> /opt/hwa/TWSDATA/Symphony; Sinfonia mtime 15:10 static, Symphony mtime 18:13 after deploy.
notes: Diagnostic lesson: verify which file the batchman has open (ls -l /proc/<pid>/fd) before concluding the Symphony is stale. Sinfonia is a legacy artifact in this installation.

claim: planman showinfo on the master reports Plan last update 08/27/2026 15:10 and Run number 18, matching the Sinfonia mtime; the deploy at 18:13 wrote /opt/hwa/TWSDATA/Symphony (505376 bytes, same size as Sinfonia). DB plan and disk Symphony are therefore consistent: there was NO plan/database corruption.
source_url: planman showinfo output on local MDM (10.2.8.0)
supporting_quote: Run number: 18; Confirm run number: 18; Plan last update: 08/27/2026 15:10; production plan 08/27 03:00 -> 08/28 02:59.
notes: A planman reset or JnextPlan would have been destructive and unnecessary.

claim: WSL2 regenerated /etc/hosts (mtime 2026-08-26 06:48, header "automatically generated by WSL") and dropped the deliberate lab alias 127.0.0.1 MDMHOST. getent hosts MDMHOST fails. The alias is required because JobManager.ini and JobManagerGW.ini reference MDMHOST in EventProcessorHostname, FullyQualifiedHostname, ResourceAdvisorUrl and BackupResourceAdvisorUrls (https://MDMHOST:31116/JobManagerRESTWeb/JobScheduler/resource).
source_url: local /etc/hosts, getent hosts MDMHOST, /opt/hwa/TWSDATA/ITA/cpa/config/JobManager.ini and JobManagerGW.ini
notes: WSL overwrites /etc/hosts on every boot unless [network] generateHosts=false is set in /etc/wsl.conf. The runbook documented MDMHOST as a deliberate loopback alias; a WSL restart silently removed it.

claim: With MDMHOST unresolved, the dynamic agent runtime in the JobManager process fails every resource registration: JobManager_message.log floods AWSITA081E wrapping AWSITA366E "Could not resolve hostname" for https://MDMHOST:31116/JobManagerRESTWeb/JobScheduler/resource (every ~60s, observed 04:21 through 18:26). Mailman fails to link the broker with AWSDEB052E (getaddrinfo: Name or service not known) + AWSBCV035W, and Batchman loops MY:UNLINK run number 18 for MDMDA/MASTERAGENTS/MDM_DWB.
source_url: stdlist/JM/JobManager_message.log and stdlist/logs/20260827_TWSMERGE.log on local master
supporting_quote: AWSITA081E ... AWSITA366E ... Could not resolve hostname; AWSBCV035W Mailman was unable to link to workstation: MDM_DWB; AWSBDY103I Received command MY:UNLINK for run number 18 for workstation MDMDA.
notes: The service itself was UP: curl https://localhost:31116/twsd/ returned HTTP 200 while https://MDMHOST:31116/twsd/ returned HTTP 000. DNS, not the engine, was the fault.

claim: conman showcpus during the failure shows the dynamic agent stranded on the previous plan run: MDM run 18, MDMDA run 17 with empty state (no LTI flags), while MDMXA (extended agent, unixlocl method) is LINKED on run 18. The agent therefore never received the new Symphony (run 18) deployed by planman, producing the agent-side symptom "not got the latest Symphony file version" on start.
source_title: Agent stranded on previous plan run
supporting_quote: MDM 18 *UNIX MASTER ... I J M EA; MDMDA 17 UNIX AGENT ... (no state); MDMXA 18 OTHR X-AGENT ... LXI JX.
notes: A workstation RUN number lower than the master RUN number means the plan (Symphony) has not been delivered to that workstation. Check DNS/hosts before assuming plan corruption.

claim: Fix for the MDMHOST DNS failure in the WSL2 lab: append "127.0.0.1 MDMHOST" to /etc/hosts (immediate effect) and add "[network] generateHosts = false" to /etc/wsl.conf so the manual alias survives future WSL restarts. No planman reset, no JnextPlan and no job history loss are required. Backups: /etc/hosts.bak-20260827-symphonyfix, /etc/wsl.conf.bak-20260827-symphonyfix.
supporting_quote: getent hosts MDMHOST -> 127.0.0.1 MDMHOST; curl https://MDMHOST:31116/twsd/ -> HTTP 200 after fix (was 000).
notes: Adding the entry to the Windows hosts file (C:\Windows\System32\drivers\etc\hosts) is an alternative persistence mechanism, since WSL merges it during regeneration.

claim: Self-healing sequence after the DNS fix (no manual link/start commands needed): 18:27:27 first AWSITA083I "Resource information was sent"; by 18:35 conman showcpus shows all workstations LINKED on run 18 (MDMDA LBI J M, MDM_DWB LTI JW, MASTERAGENTS LBI J); at 18:37:31 real jobs complete SUCCESSFULLY on MDMDA (MDMDA#RC_EVERY_TEST.DS_CHAIN_A ... has completed SUCCESSFULLY).
source_url: stdlist/JM/JobManager_message.log (AWSITA083I), conman showcpus, 20260827_TWSMERGE.log on local master
supporting_quote: AWSITA083I Resource information was sent ...; MDMDA 18 UNIX AGENT 08/27/26 18:35 LBI J M; Job MDMDA#RC_EVERY_TEST[...].DS_CHAIN_A has completed SUCCESSFULLY.
notes: The agent registration cycle (~60s) and mailman link cycle (~11min) re-established connectivity without operator intervention once the hostname resolved. The deployed Symphony run 18 reached MDMDA automatically.

claim: EngineServer/Workload Broker REST is served on port 31116 and was NOT the failure point: java engineServer (Open Liberty, PID 150069) kept listening on *:31116 and *:31115 throughout; only the MDMHOST name was unresolvable. The deploy pipeline was healthy: engineServer logged AWSDPM001I "The workstation MDMDA will be notified about a new available configuration" at 18:13:51 (planman deploy) and AWSDPM002I "has requested a new configuration" at 18:29:38.
source_url: ss -tlnp and engineServer logs/messages.log on local master
source_title: Deploy pipeline healthy; DNS was the only fault
supporting_quote: LISTEN *:31116 java 150069; AWSDPM001I The workstation "MDMDA" will be notified about a new available configuration.
notes: Deploy notifications were being emitted correctly; the agent could not fetch the configuration while MDMHOST was unresolvable.

claim: Distinguish real plan corruption from DNS/link failure: with DNS failure the master-side plan state is consistent (planman showinfo run 18, Symphony file updated by deploy, batchman LIVES run 18) while only the workstation linkage and agent plan delivery are broken. planman resync/checksync/deploy do NOT fix hostname resolution; running them against an unresolved alias keeps the agent on the previous run.
source_url: planman showinfo, conman showcpus, TWSMERGE log cross-check on local master
source_title: Plan corruption vs DNS/link failure discrimination
supporting_quote: batchman LIVES run 18 with consistent DB and Symphony; MDMDA stranded on run 17 solely because the resource registration POST never reached the server.
notes: Diagnostic rule: when the master is healthy but an agent is stranded on run N-1, verify hostname resolution (getent hosts <node>) and the batchman open-file list before any destructive plan operation.
